Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date (EDGAR's acceptance time in ET; after the 16:00 close, the next trading day). From 2013 (the 2013-2017 and 2018-2021 batches, sources CR39-CR76) the facts are SEC's XBRL company facts of the 10-Qs and 10-Ks only (a reduced-data batch, 'reduced_data'): each value is the tagged figure of its filing, kept in 'rows' as tag, period and value.

'The market for CRM applications is intensely competitive and rapidly changing, barriers to entry are relatively low, several of our competitors are larger and have more resources than we do, and with the introduction of new technologies and market entrants, we expect competition to intensify in the future.'
